key.name: active-hint
key.summary: Show a hint around the active window

key.name: active-hint-border-radius
key.summary: Border radius for active window hint, in pixels

key.name: active-hint-border-width
key.summary: Border width for window hints, in pixels

key.name: round-windows
key.summary: Round window corners to match the hints (costs a GPU buffer per visible window)

key.name: panel-hint
key.summary: Draw the active hint around the top bar, while the theme's top bar border is transparent

key.name: inactive-hint
key.summary: Show a hint around unfocused windows

key.name: inactive-hint-color-rgba
key.summary: Start (top-left) color of the unfocused window hint, in RGBA

key.name: inactive-hint-color-end-rgba
key.summary: End (bottom-right) color of the unfocused window hint, in RGBA. Empty for a solid color

key.name: inactive-dim
key.summary: Opacity of the black overlay dimming unfocused windows (0 disables dimming)

key.name: active-hint-glow
key.summary: Blur radius in pixels of a soft glow around the focused window, in the hint colors (0 disables it)

key.name: active-hint-glow-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the focused window's glow

key.name: focus-flash
key.summary: When focus moves by keyboard, flash the newly focused window's glow and fade it over this many milliseconds (0 disables it)

key.name: float-rules
key.summary: Windows that float instead of tiling
key.description: Each entry is (class, title): case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the window's WM class and title; an empty one matches anything. Checked before the exceptions in ~/.config/pop-shell/config.json and pop-shell's built-in ones.

key.name: float-above
key.summary: Keep floating windows above tiled windows

key.name: float-center
key.summary: Center floating windows on their monitor when they open

key.name: float-min-size
key.summary: Minimum size of floating windows, as a percentage of the monitor's work area (0 disables)

key.name: workspace-rules
key.summary: App to workspace rules
key.description: Each entry is (class, workspace, monitor, on-open). class is a case-insensitive regular expression matched against the window's WM class and instance; workspace counts from 1; monitor is '' (any), 'primary', 'secondary' or a connector name such as 'eDP-1'. Windows on a monitor outside the workspaces (workspaces-only-on-primary) ignore the workspace, which is used when that monitor is not connected. on-open moves new windows as they open; without it the rule only applies when windows are rebalanced (the rebalance-windows key, or a monitor change).

key.name: workspace-back-and-forth
key.summary: Pressing the current workspace's key switches back to the previous workspace

key.name: startup-workspace
key.summary: Workspace to switch to at login, hiding the overview (counts from 1, 0 disables)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-1
key.summary: Switch to workspace 1 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-2
key.summary: Switch to workspace 2 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-3
key.summary: Switch to workspace 3 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-4

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-5

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-6
key.summary: Switch to workspace 6 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-7
key.summary: Switch to workspace 7 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-8
key.summary: Switch to workspace 8 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-9
key.summary: Switch to workspace 9 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: pop-switch-workspace-10
key.summary: Switch to workspace 10 (again: back to the previous workspace)

key.name: rebalance-windows

key.name: animate-tiling
